content:
Let \(t\) be the time for the first pump to drain one-half of the pond.

First pump’s rate:
\[
\frac{1/2}{t}=\frac{1}{2t}\text{ pond per hour}
\]

Second pump’s rate:
\[
\frac{1}{1.25}=\frac{4}{5}\text{ pond per hour}
\]

Since both pumps together drain 1 full pond in \(0.5\) hours:
\[
0.5\left(\frac{1}{2t}+\frac{4}{5}\right)=1
\]
\[
\frac{1}{2t}+\frac{4}{5}=2
\]
\[
\frac{1}{2t}=\frac{6}{5}
\]
\[
2t=\frac{5}{6}
\]
\[
t=\frac{5}{12}\text{ hours}
\]

\[
\boxed{\frac{5}{12}\text{ hours}}
\]
